parameters.excerpt: Implementations may implement `mseccfg` such that `[s,u]seed` is a read-only constant value `0`.
parameters.reasoning: The spec permits implementations to make mseccfg.sseed and mseccfg.useed read-only constant 0 (disallowing U/S-mode access) or read-write. This is an implementation choice controlling the read-only vs read-write nature of these CSR fields.
